response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile individual contributor with 15+ years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, embedded and high-throughput systems, but the resume shows no executive or people-leadership experience — no evidence of managing engineers, building a technical leadership layer, or scaling a team from 10 to 30+. The role's hard requirements around production multi-agent AI systems, AI in regulated/high-stakes financial contexts, and governing outsourced delivery models are essentially unaddressed; AI exposure is limited to recent MCP/agent tooling contributions as a staff engineer. Fintech exposure (RIDE Capital) is peripheral rather than credit/risk infrastructure. This is a mismatch of seniority and domain, not a marginal gap.
strengths: Deep, broad hands-on engineering across 15+ years and many stacks
Real low-latency/microservices experience at Sociomantic (millions of req/sec)
Strong engineering-craft culture: TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, teaching and OSS founding
concerns: No evidence of engineering management, hiring, or team scaling
No production multi-agent AI systems or LLM evaluation/observability ownership
Minimal fintech-infrastructure or regulated-environment AI experience

key_factors.factor: Distributed systems and low-latency backend depth
